svg.title: The layers of relate's Cypher dialect
svg.desc: openCypher, measured by the TCK, is the floor. Cypher 25 and its GQL-aligned syntax sit on top and are on by default. Preview features sit above that and run only when RELATE_PREVIEW names them. Server-only features, such as multiple databases and access control, are outside the dialect and fail with a typed error.
